items.headline: Eye on the price: Retail inflation at 5.54% in September, most on new base
items.summary: India's retail inflation increased to 5.54% year-on-year in September, the highest since January. This rise is attributed to higher food prices, particularly onions and other essentials.

items.headline: Japan's wholesale inflation remains elevated, keeps alive BOJ rate-hike view
items.summary: TOKYO, Oct 13 (Reuters) - Japan's wholesale prices rose 6.8% in the year to September as companies passed on fuel and chemical costs, according to data released on Tuesday, highlighting mounting inflationary pressure that keeps alive market expectations of a near-term interest rate hike.
